summary: Independent review of amdpilot-org/sglang PR 769 at 3fb9e346d437e25b07aa699613d7a1eceb751410 verified that the prepared base silently accepts compressed-tensors W4A8 MoE group_size=64 while all six CUTLASS call sites use chunk_size=128. The candidate adds an initialization-time fail-closed check: group_size=128 remains accepted and non-128 values are rejected before weights can load or inference can serve silently mis-scaled output.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual scheme constructor accepted group_size values 128, 64, 1, 127, 129, 256, and -64. This independently reproduces the issue's silent acceptance precondition, including the reported group_size=64 case.
The exact candidate imported from /job/repo/python, accepted group_size=128, and raised the documented ValueError for independent adversarial values 64, 1, 127, 129, 256, and -64.
Candidate regression: 4 passed; supported 128 constructs and tested unsupported 64, 127, and 256 reject.
Related mocked DeepEP W4A8 MoE path remained passing: 1 passed.
Architecture qualification only: all 605 CUTLASS numerical cases skipped on AMD gfx950 because they require NVIDIA sm90.
Changed Python source and candidate regression compile successfully.

gpu_execution_evidence: Assigned hardware was one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. The affected CUTLASS kernel requires NVIDIA Hopper sm90; issue-relevant GPU execution was therefore unsupported.
remaining_limitations: No H100/sm90 GPU and no affected compressed-tensors W4A8 MoE model weights were available, so full-model serving, semantic accuracy, direct CUTLASS numerical output, and the issue's secondary K-per-rank TP/EP observation were not reproduced. The candidate intentionally rejects every non-128 group size; it does not implement group_size=64 kernel support. No native source changed, so rebuilding native code was not required.
